text.tspan: Share of purchases at each displayed position. Blue bars: forward product order; gray bars: reversed. Dashed
Pilot preview: built only to test the figure code, not a finding.

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Request types S0, S1 and V pooled. Bars: 95% Wilson intervals (they treat purchases as independent, so they are too narrow when one task
repeats). Product order is part of every test cell, so position is held fixed by design and cannot explain a name gap. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite:
purchases come from very few tasks; read the bars as task-specific.
Paired position effect on price (reversed minus forward, PLAN 5.2, a method check): Claude Haiku 5.5 -4.0%; Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite +0.2%.
Exploratory note for networks: an agent that buys mostly from the top slots rewards whoever controls the ranking.
